title: Build: a multi-year sub-hour candle lane for the Alpaca ETFs and IBKR futures proxies (Yahoo serves ~60 d at 5m/15m and ~730 d at 1h), so the short-arm break-even and breakout units can measure equities below 1h at power
note: Programme 07 TIMEFRAMES short arm, data gap.
